definitions.explanation: A young woman training to become a geisha, typically found in Kyoto's geisha districts. Maiko are recognized by their distinctive elaborate hairstyles, colorful long-sleeved kimono, and trailing obi sash. Composed of 舞 (dance) + 妓 (female entertainer).

examples.japanese: ⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{舞妓|まいこ}さん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: I met a maiko in Kyoto.

examples.japanese: {舞妓|まいこ}さん⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{花街|かがい}→花街：17224_kagai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}いている→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: The sight of a maiko walking through the geisha district is beautiful.

examples.japanese: {舞妓|まいこ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦{修業|しゅぎょう}→修業：16906_shugyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経|へ}て→経る：13876_heru⟧、⟦やがて→やがて：03637_yagate⟧{芸妓|げいこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: A maiko undergoes rigorous training and eventually becomes a full geisha.

notes:
USAGE:
{舞妓|まいこ} specifically refers to an apprentice geisha, primarily in Kyoto. The polite form {舞妓|まいこ}さん is commonly used. After completing training (typically around age 20), a {舞妓|まいこ} becomes a {芸妓|げいこ} (full geisha).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {舞妓|まいこ}さん (maiko — polite form)
- {舞妓|まいこ}⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧ (maiko experience — dressing up as a maiko)
- {舞妓|まいこ}⟦デビュー→デビュー：11016_debyuu⟧ ({店出|みせだ}し — a maiko's debut)

CULTURAL NOTE:
{舞妓|まいこ} are most associated with Kyoto's five ⟦{花街|かがい}→花街：17224_kagai⟧ (geisha districts), especially {祇園|ぎおん}. In Kyoto, a full geisha is called {芸妓|げいこ} rather than ⟦{芸者|げいしゃ}→芸者：14149_geisha⟧.
